name: hub
actions: window.__lines = () => { const rows = [...document.querySelectorAll('#combo-table tbody.combo-group')].filter(g => !g.querySelector('.combo-parent-row')); const stat = rows.map(g => { const n = g.querySelector('.notation-text'); const tops = new Set([...n.querySelectorAll('.recipe-step')].map(c => Math.round(c.getBoundingClientRect().top))); const cmd = g.querySelector('.combo-cmd').getBoundingClientRect(), sub = g.querySelector('.combo-sub').getBoundingClientRect(); return { id: g.dataset.comboId, lines: tops.size, subSame: Math.abs(sub.top - cmd.top) < cmd.height }; }); return JSON.stringify({ total: stat.length, oneLine: stat.filter(s => s.lines === 1).length, wrapped: stat.filter(s => s.lines > 1).map(s => s.id), subSameLine: stat.filter(s => s.subSame).length, overflowX: document.documentElement.scrollWidth > innerWidth }); }
